alate: Head brown tinged with red, sparsely covered with pubescence and setae; the dorsum of the thorax and abdomen yellowish brown, the pronotum rather densely haired; wing membrane white and veins brown. Head flat and rounded; fontanelle oval, without a pale round spot in front of it; compound eyes circular, their long diameter about three times the distance between them and the lower margin of the head; the long diameter of the ocelli about four times the ocellus-compound eye distance; labrum semicircular; postclypeus trapezoidal, slightly more than half as long as wide; antennae with 15 segments, the third shortest; antennal spot circular but indistinct, smaller than the ocelli; the anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum nearly straight, the lateral margins slightly oblique backwards.
distribution: Dabu and Huiyang, Guangdong; Dongxing and Wuming, Guangxi.
soldier: Head pale yellowish brown to yellowish brown, sparsely covered with short pubescence, the tips of the mandibles brown, thorax and abdomen yellowish white. Head slightly square, the sides parallel, the anterior and posterior margins nearly straight; fontanelle punctiform and slightly projecting; labrum semicircular; mandibles hooked, each with a large blunt tooth at or slightly before the apical third, and only one small sharp tooth above the base of each; antennae with 14 segments, the third slightly longer than the second; postmentum club-shaped, the waist 0.28–0.35 mm wide; pronotum saddle-shaped, its posterior margin nearly straight.
